capability: Odd joins wait for a person before they count
title: Odd joins wait for a person.

hook.picture: Close on the whale as pods stream cards onto a fast line. One card is oddly shaped, bent at the corners, and slides in with the rest.
hook.words: The bot merged it. Nobody looked.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The bot merged something weird, and nobody looked at it.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: ops lead reading the weekly report

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three more bent cards slip through: every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Each lands in a report.

stakes.body: A strange result reaches a leader's report with no person ever having looked at it, and decisions get made on it.

solution_hint: Let odd parts wait for a person.

metaphor.body: A fast line of agent cards. Joins that look odd get set aside on a short side branch with an empty person chip, and they only rejoin after a tick from a reviewer.

steps.picture: A dashed join mark appears wherever two cards meet. Matching edges tick teal and pass straight through.
steps.words: Odd parts wait. A person looks first.
steps.sound: Knock and chord on each tick.

steps.picture: The bent card arrives. Its join reads the edges, the chip shows a question shape, and the card is set aside on the side branch beside the empty person chip.
steps.words: Where parts meet, a seam sorts them.
steps.sound: A knock, then a held, open chord.

steps.picture: Push-in. The whale, now the reviewer, swims to the side branch, turns the bent card over, and stamps a tick. Only then does it rejoin the line.
steps.sound: The open chord resolves on the stamp.

steps.picture: Two more joins: a broken one stays shut (raw sienna), a missing one stays empty. Neither card moves on.
steps.words: Broken or missing never moves on.

real_case.claim: In cell-sheaf-swarm a strange edge (map exists, rank or sort odd) folds into the trunk only after a person; broken and missing never fold.

honest_limit.picture: A smooth, normal-looking card with a raw sienna smudge inside meets its join, matches, gets ok, and passes straight to the line. It never visits the person.
honest_limit.words: A neat mistake never reaches the person.

not_this.body: Only odd shapes get a human look.

ending_pattern.body: The bent card from bar 1 now waits on the side branch beside the person chip while the bundle ships clean, then rejoins after a tick.
ending_pattern.callback: The bent card that slid into the report in bar 1 is held beside the same line, in the same framing.

end_belief.body: Let odd results wait for a person.

beats.words: The bot merged it. Nobody looked.
beats.sound: Quick paper flicks, a clipped woodblock knock.

beats.picture: The bundle ships with the bent card inside. A pod downstream reads it and answers with a raw sienna ✕ chip.
beats.sound: A knock with no chord after it.

beats.picture: A second pod copies the first pod's answer. Two ✕ chips now, on the report card at the end of the line.
beats.words: Now the weird bit is in my report.
beats.sound: Two clipped knocks.

beats.picture: The whale stares at the bent card, now buried in the report. Hold.
beats.sound: Silence creeps in.

beats.sound: Near-silence, then the title tick.
beats.camera: still (half a bar of stillness first)

beats.picture: Pull back. The line is a conveyor with no stops; everything that arrives gets merged.
beats.sound: Room tone, then the problem motif once.

beats.picture: Three more bent cards slip through: every 2 beats, then 1, then a half. Each lands in a report.
beats.sound: Problem motif three times, accelerating.

beats.picture: All motion stops. A short side branch ghosts in beside the line, with an empty person chip on it.
beats.words: Let odd parts wait for a person.
beats.sound: The first clean signature: a knock and its chord.

beats.picture: The whale clears the side branch one card at a time; each gets a tick before it rejoins.
beats.words: Each one cleared by hand, then kept.

beats.picture: Same close framing as bar 1. The bent card arrives again, but it rests on the side branch while the bundle ships without it. The downstream pod answers ✓.
beats.sound: A knock, then a full chord.

beats.picture: The whale reaches it, stamps a tick, and it rejoins. Spark.
beats.sound: Full resolution.

beats.picture: The line with its small side branch, the whale breathing.
beats.words: Let odd results wait for a person.
beats.sound: Pad tail.

beats.picture: SERIES.lockup over the settled chart ground.
beats.sound: Lockup sting, then the room tone tail.
